placementChanges.purpose: Move source-series resistor to the same east routing side as UART/SWD/USB services; avoid actual18-28mm westward detour and release south-west GPIO window. pin1(45.6016,19.9),pin2(47.1764,19.9).
Move +.6X/-1.1Y to release leftGPIO bank while preserving direct TOP cap loops; VDD leg slightly longer, VSS leg shorter, total loop length modestly reduced.
Free PB8/PB9 source copper, maintain local direct VDD/VSS loop
BOOT0 pulldown removes old ground pad/thermal obstruction from PB5 fanout

placementChanges.reason: Orient existing receiver-series resistor across GPIO_PA15 routing row: PA10 input pad23.4626 and externalUART pad25.0374 lie on opposite sides, .2175nominal copper-to-row clearance. This opens pin2 routing without closing another signal layer or adding spare vias.
